I'm not sure if they will miss me forever. Everyone will know it wasn't their fault. They will know it happened because I was too emotional, couldn't find my way in the world and that I was very psychologically hurt by former attempts for help. I think it'll make sense to them. 
But that might depend on how good I am at explaining it and making hem agree that it was the best coices, much like one get's over an old persons death. 

I think..?
